notes: Adds automatic Document Change Impact review for replacement controlled-document versions. Managers/Admins see each replacement checked against direct pairwise document links, linked/current training and active assignments. Pending replacements can be reviewed before approval; newly approved replacements from this build onward remain flagged until impact is reviewed. Reviews are auditable in Supabase with outcome, note, reviewer, timestamp and an impact snapshot, and automatically reopen if linked documents/training/assignments change after the recorded review. Training still pointing at an older approved source version is flagged red. Direct Go there links are added to Documents, Safety Actions and role-aware Help. Includes all v2.10.39 Unified Safety Actions, v2.10.38 Help and v2.10.37 flicker fixes.
